title.narrative: Revenue Mobilization Thematic Fund (RMTF)

description.narrative: Malawi- Revenue Administration Project Project Purpose: The purpose of the project is to provide CD to the government of Malawi to strengthen management of revenue administration, governance arrangements and core functions of tax administration. Expected Results: The project will contribute to significant improvements in the effectiveness of the MRA¿s tax administration, in two broad areas: 1.Building on the TADAT assessment a medium-term reform strategy (a revised strategic plan) will be designed to improve and modernize the MRA and help increase revenue performance. The strategy will build on the current Strategic Plan and incorporate the findings of the TADAT assessment and the FAD March 2018 mission. It will also build upon the foundational reforms that have already been set in train and are supported by the AFRITAC East and other partners in Malawi. 2.Tax administration core processes will be further strengthened. Achieving the government¿s revenue collection expectations will require substantially higher levels of taxpayer compliance. Improvement of core processes is a prerequisite to supporting voluntary and enforced compliance. In this regard, compliance programs and action plans described above are dependent on the effectiveness of the core processes.

comment.narrative: Although the Ontime payments rates by value are very high for VAT 88.6 percent they need to be qualified as the taxpayer registration database is unreliable.Stock of arrears cannot be properly determined and a D rating was assessed P515.

title.narrative: The Integrity of the taxpayer register, and ledgers is strengthened

description.narrative: More accurate and reliable taxpayer information held in centralized database (TADAT POA11); Knowledge of taxpayer base and potential taxpayers improved through robust taxpayer registration policies and procedures (TADAT POA12).

comment.narrative: The integrity of the taxpayer registration database is low P11 actions to identify unregistered taxpayer are ado P12 Fundamentally the number of active taxpayers is uncertain.
The accuracy and reliability of the taxpayer register and knowledge of the potential taxpayer base both move to B scores.

Significant progress has been made on updating the registration details with all the large taxpayer details who had submitted the Know Your Customer KYC forms updated and migrated to the MO system. Progress has also been made on the reconciling of the Income Tax ledgers.
